tools.name: match_jobs_to_profile
tools.description: Rank live remote jobs against a job seeker's profile (titles, skills, level, country, minimum pay) and say why each fits and what it also asks for. Build the profile from the person's resume or what they told you; only jobs they can take from their country are ranked.

tools.name: remote_jobs_open_to_country
tools.description: How many live remote jobs a person living in a given country can actually take, and the newest of them. Most 'remote' listings are limited to one country; this applies that rule.

tools.name: search_remote_jobs
tools.description: Search live remote job listings by role, skill or company. Pass the job seeker's country to get only jobs they can legally take from where they live.
